title: Translation: codons of mRNA specify amino acids
caption: The ribosome reads the mRNA three bases at a time. The start codon AUG brings in methionine; each following codon adds one amino acid; the stop codon UAA ends the chain and releases the polypeptide.
alt: An mRNA divided into codons with the amino acid each codes for: Met, Gly, Pro, Lys, then the stop codon.
description: AUG is the start codon: methionine.
The next codons give Gly, Pro, Lys.
UAA is a stop codon: no amino acid, the chain is released.
